classification.confirmed_application_defect: AI-BS Windows non-delete-sharing readers can block atomic private-status/HLS publication. Recorded controller terminal code STATUS_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE.
classification.causality_limit: The HLS rename error is separate from the controller terminal status-write error. Its presence alone is not proof it directly caused shutdown.

incident.reproduction: Isolated C Windows fixtures reproduce denied atomic replacement while readers are open. Shared-delete reads plus bounded retries publish after brief readers close; immediate open-handle replacement remains unsupported on this host.
incident.repair: FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE|DELETE bounded local reads; classified5/32/33 atomic-replace retries; Qt playback through fixed loopback HTTP9011 instead of directly opening the writer playlist.
